title: The Prospects for 128 Bit Processors ( John Mashey SGI 1995)
summary: John Mashey from SGI authored this 1995 article exploring the rationale, challenges, and timeline for potential 128-bit processor architectures, examining address space requirements, data processing needs, and the transition from 64-bit computing.
problem_solved: Examines whether and when computing needs would justify moving beyond 64-bit processors to 128-bit architectures.
why_valuable: Provides a historical perspective on processor evolution predictions from a leading computer architect, offering insights into how technology forecasting was conducted in the mid-1990s.
